additional_info.subject: RE: ID0370439-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / P9 170000981] Display was green CRM:00642001331
additional_info.body:
Hello Jakub,
Hope you are doing good.
As mentioned, the DP cable was replaced according to Q2302 the HMI needs to be updated accordingly.
Kindly find below attached instructions and files.
Instruction for software and FW installation
2.1. Preliminary:
Software:
Software Siemens Blackpanel Upgrade
file attached in mail
Firmware for Serial numbers higher than 21102890000810:
LT7911D_DP_to_2port_LVDS_1920X1080_20230217_0x0C_275mV_checksum_0x19AB2D
file attached in mail
Firmware for serial numbers 21102865000001 to 21102865000668/
Firmware for serial numbers 21102890000001 to 21102890000810:
LT7911D_DP_to_2port_LVDS_1920X1080_20230515_0x0F_525mV_checksum_0x19A813
file attached in mail
Open "Software Siemens Blackpanel Upgrade.zip"
double click Driver/CH341PAR.exe
click "INSTALL"
2.2. Materials:
Win10 PC
I2C↔ USB-A adapter
24V power supply with 3 pin plug to power the display controller
If you need to build your own I²C↔ USB-A adapter:
GND = black
SCL = yellow
SDA = red
Plug: 2mm grid size 3-pin
2.3. Operations
2.3.1. Hardware
1.Unplug all connectors from the display controller
2.Remove the metal cover from the display controller by unscrewing the four screws
3.Plug the usb adapter onto the 3-pin connector of the controller (& computer)
4.Plug an external 24V power supply  onto the controller
2.3.2.  Software
1.Open the program "Siemens Upgrade/Upgrade_Flash_For_Application.exe"
2.Add the firmware "LT7911D_DP_to_2port_LVDS_1920X1080_20230217_0x0C_275mV_checksum_0x19AB2D.hex" by pressing the folder icon
3.Flash the program by pressing the pencil icon
4.Close the program after it has reached 100%
twice
5.Done.
For your more information you can find below Q feedback
SI E Q-Feedback Q2302 Sicharge D - HMI Backlight Off and Scrambled Image Due to R... - ID: 109816666 - Industry Support Siemens
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Mohini
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.
